lines.text: That was our street.
I know. Thought we'd go by the swings.
What for?
Nothing. It's been a while.
You used to duck driving past here.
Cherry could spot those swings dead asleep.
And there you'd be, pushing her in her pajamas.
You always said one more push.
She had the hiccups from laughing. I liked that.
We could go round by the school, too.
Benny, could you take this next left?
Yeah. Sure.
I did like going past the swings.
I should've asked.
I just miss talking in the car.
I've been thinking about that front step since lunch.
The step?
It's still warm around now. The girls won't be back till five.
I wanted to take my shoes off and sit there.
Oh. And I drove right past it.
Twice, if you'd had your way.
Thought you might want this.
Get yours too?
You know what I miss about those drives?
What?
We used to pick a house we'd buy.
Little green one with the crooked porch?
You picked that one every time.
